en.headline: Two men arrested in Mong Kok anti-drug operations
en.dek: Police say a commercial unit on Dundas Street was used as a drug den and a street stop later yielded suspected drugs worth about HK$13,000.
body: Mong Kok police arrested two men on Monday in separate anti-drug actions, including an operation targeting a suspected drug den in a commercial building.

The district anti-triad unit said that after intelligence work it launched an operation code-named Fairlaw. Officers arrested a 39-year-old local man surnamed Cheung in a commercial building on Dundas Street on suspicion of permitting or suffering premises to be used as a divan or for the unlawful trafficking of dangerous drugs. Police said he was suspected of renting the unit for that purpose and that they were contacting the owner to recover the premises.

On the same day, officers on patrol stopped a man at the junction of Shanghai Street and Cheong Sha Street. They seized 90 suspected midazolam tablets, about 4 grams of suspected heroin, about 10 grams of suspected ice and about 3 grams of suspected crack cocaine, with a total estimated value of about HK$13,000. A 51-year-old local man surnamed Lai was arrested on suspicion of trafficking in dangerous drugs.

Both men were being detained for inquiries. Mong Kok District Criminal Investigation Team 2 is handling the street case. Police reminded landlords, agents and tenants that allowing premises to be used for illegal activity can carry criminal liability.

zh.headline: 旺角商廈單位涉毒窟 警拘兩男檢1.3萬元毒品
zh.dek: 旺角反三合會行動組周一展開「明法」行動，在登打士街商廈拘捕39歲男子；同日在街上截查再拘51歲男子。
body: 旺角警方星期一在區內兩項反毒行動中拘捕兩名男子，其中一宗涉及商業大廈單位懸疑用作毒窟。
旺角警區反三合會行動組表示，經情報分析後展開代號「明法」的打擊毒窟行動，在登打士街一幢商業大廈拘捕一名39歲姓張本地男子，涉嫌准許或容受處所用作為煙窟或作非法販運危險藥物之用。警方指他懸疑租用該單位作有關用途，並正與業主接洽，以收回單位阻止活動持續。
同日，人員在上海街及長沙街交界截查一名形跡可疑男子，在其身上檢獲90粒懸疑咪達啟仑、約4克懸疑海洛英、約10克懸疑冰毒及約3克懸疑霹靂可卡因，總市值約1.3萬元。51歲姓黎本地男子涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕。
兩名男子現正被扣留調查，街上案件由旺角警區刑事調查隊第二隊跟進。警方提醒業主、代理及租客，容許處所經營非法活動可能要負上刑責。
